categories.name: Epoxy Flooring
categories.description: Our suppliers sell & install high-quality epoxy flooring in Sri Lanka in various different formats at competitive prices. Epoxy flooring can withstand heavy traffic such as lorries & forklifts, making it ideal for cargo loading docks and factories with heavy vehicles. It is also resistant to most oil and chemical spills and can be cleaned easily, making it suitable for manufacturing factories, vehicle repair and service facilities, and commercial spaces. The high-grip, non-slip surface makes epoxy flooring ideal for sports facilities like gymnasiums, badminton courts, basketball courts and schools. Hi-Build Epoxy Flooring also known as 3-coat Epoxy Flooring , is the most durable form of epoxy flooring, and is accomplished by applying 3-layers by roller. Though this form of epoxy flooring is the most cost effective, it is the most suitable for high-traffic and heavy use environments.  Self-levelling Epoxy Flooring is available in both high-gloss and matte finishes, and is achieved by applying a base primer followed by pouring the self-levelling epoxy resign. It is visually superior to hi-build epoxy flooring, and therefore suitable for commercial spaces, gymnasiums and even residential spaces. Self-levelling epoxy is also commonly applied in food manufacturing factories as it is considered a Food Grade material due to the lack of toxic substances.  Flake Chip Flooring & Metallic Epoxy Flooring are variations of self-levelling epoxy. In the case of flake chip flooring, the flakes are spread after applying the self-levelling epoxy, and then protected by a final top coat. In the case of metallic epoxy flooring, multiple colours of self-levelling epoxy are poured together to create the desired effect.  3D Epoxy Flooring is created by embedding an image or small particles in epoxy to give a visually three dimensional depth to the floor. 3D epoxy flooring can be applied to residential areas like kitchens and bathrooms, as well as commercial spaces such as retail stores, cinemas, children's play areas and theme parks, due to its visual appeal.

It removes harmful chemicals but minimal essential minerals, which mostly come from food. What are the key benefits of using a reverse osmosis water filtration system? RO systems remove up to 99% of contaminants, improve taste, reduce plastic waste, and protect appliances from scale buildup. Does a reverse osmosis water system waste water? Traditional RO systems waste about 3-4 gallons per gallon purified. Efficiency can improve with pumps or reusing wastewater for gardening. Do I need a reverse osmosis water filtration system at home? If your water has contaminants or you want safer, better-tasting water, an RO system is beneficial. Otherwise, it’s optional for clean municipal water. Where is the best place to install a reverse osmosis water filtration system? Usually under the kitchen sink; also possible for refrigerators or aquariums.
